arcs.title: Dana and the basil cups
arcs.stage: 2/5 — He knows about the basil leaves now (Sat in the park). Today at the cafe he asks her something real: how she knows plants.

arcs.title: Saving Moshe
arcs.stage: 1/3 — Dana's tip: stop drowning him. Ishai is trying (badly) to water less. Tonight Moshe meets Falafel.

arcs.title: The big client
arcs.stage: 2/4 — Working on 'bigger but smaller'. Tonight he sends version seven.

arcs.title: Getting a TV
arcs.stage: Today 09:30–12:30 — Avi's cousin brings the old TV (director goal 'tv').

arcs.title: Falafel the dog
arcs.stage: The stray has appeared at Avi's kiosk. Today 13:30–18:00 Ishai adopts him and names him Falafel; first night at home.

beats.goal: First workday of the week. Ishai walks apartment -> corridor -> street -> cafe for his usual extra-shot coffee, a little nervous after talking to Dana in the park on Shabbat. This time he looks at the cup before drinking: a basil leaf. He thanks her, reports that Moshe got a day off from water, and asks how she knows so much about plants (her grandmother's balcony garden in Haifa). Short and shy, other customers waiting; she says one dry thing that makes him smile. He mentions the stray at Avi's kiosk. No date yet.
beats.forceText: At the counter Ishai turns his cup and finds a basil leaf drawn in the foam. He looks up; Dana is already looking.

forceLines.say: I checked the cup this time.
Took you three weeks. How's Moshe?

forceCommentary.say: He CHECKED THE CUP. Somebody hold me.
Three weeks to notice foam. The client wants a faster designer.

moments.text: Ishai takes his coffee, turns the cup, and sees the basil leaf in the foam.

lines.say: Extra shot. Same as always.
I checked the cup this time.
Took you three weeks. How's Moshe?
I skipped watering yesterday. It was the hardest day of my life.
He'll survive. You might not.
How do you even know plants? You make coffee.
My grandmother had a whole balcony jungle in Haifa. I was her slave every summer.
So basil is, like, your family business.
Next customer's waiting, plant dad. Go.

commentary.say: Grandmother's balcony in Haifa. She told him a FAMILY story. That's basically meeting the parents.
Moshe skipped one watering and survived. Medical miracle.

moments.text: Ishai lingers at the end of the counter with his cup; Dana wipes the machine nearby.

lines.say: There's a stray dog at Avi's kiosk. Avi feeds him falafel.
Avi feeds everyone falafel. Is the dog okay?
He looked at me like I owed him money.
Then you probably do.
Okay. Work. Bye. Thanks for the leaf.
It's foam, Ishai. Bye.

commentary.say: She said his NAME. Not extra-shot guy. Ishai.
A dog is coming. I can feel Moshe tensing up.

beats.goal: Ishai can't stop thinking about the stray. He goes back to Avi's kiosk, gets Avi's blessing, names the dog Falafel and brings him home through the building corridor (Mrs. Levi has strong opinions about dogs and then falls in love). Spread it over several moments. Complete in the moment Falafel arrives in apartment 4.
beats.forceText: Ishai carries the scruffy stray up to apartment 4 and sets him down. 'Welcome home, Falafel.' Moshe the basil has a new roommate.

forceCommentary.say: HE ADOPTED THE DOG. I need a minute. I need several minutes.
Falafel. He named a dog after lunch. Respect.

moments.text: At Avi's kiosk the sandy stray sits by the counter; Ishai crouches down to him.

lines.say: Champion! Back again? He waited for you all morning, I swear.
Avi, does he belong to anyone?
He belongs to the street. And to my falafel budget.
What if I took him? Just to try.
There's no 'try' with a dog. He picks you, you're done.
Then I'm done. What do I call him?
He eats falafel all day. Call him Falafel.
Falafel. Okay, Falafel. Let's go home.

commentary.say: Avi just officiated a wedding between a man and a dog.
Named after lunch. Moshe was named after Moshe. Moshe had dignity.

moments.text: Falafel sniffs every corner of apartment 4 and stops, very interested, at Moshe's windowsill.

lines.say: Falafel, this is Moshe. Moshe is family. We do not eat family.

commentary.say: I don't trust that sniff. Protect the basil.

beats.goal: First evening with Falafel. Ishai eats something simple, then sits at the laptop to finish the 'bigger but smaller' logo for the big client; Falafel lies on his feet. He tries versions aloud, asks Falafel's opinion, and finally sends version seven with a hopeful sigh. He waters Moshe only a little, proud of himself.
beats.forceText: Ishai hits send on logo version seven. Under the desk, Falafel snores on his feet.

forceLines.say: Version seven. Bigger, smaller, premium. Falafel, if they hate it, you bite them.

forceCommentary.say: One night with a dog and he's delegating to it. Management material.
Man, dog, laptop, basil. This is the family portrait now.

moments.text: Ishai at the laptop, logo versions side by side; Falafel asleep on his feet.

lines.say: Bigger... smaller... Falafel, which one says premium? Okay, you're right. Seven. Send.

commentary.say: The dog has better taste than the client. Low bar, but still.
He's got a dog on his feet and a girl's leaf on his cup. Growth.
